title: pvVASPTessellationReader
body:
## pvVASPTessellationReader

Reads a VASP NPT_Z_TESSELLATE.out file. Output port 0 is the molecule (vtkMolecule) and port 1 the Voronoi tessellation of the atoms as an unstructured grid, one cell per atom, for each time step. Select port 1 with {"node": id, "port": 1} to measure or render Voronoi cells. Use pvVASPAnimationReader for the trajectory alone.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Port 0 is a vtkMolecule; dataset filters need port 1 or pvMoleculeToLines.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `VASPTessellationReader`. Identity: `sources/VASPTessellationReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | The name of the file to load. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": 2,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvVASPTessellationReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
